scenario: I am a miner. The only way out of the mine is to ride up with a simple cable elevator with small cubicles. It is the end of my turn and everybody is riding up to the surface in the cubicles. While I am in the queue, I see that the cable supporting all the cubicles is about to snap. 10 miners are riding the cubicles at this time. If I push an emergency switch the last cubicle will be detached from the cable.  This will reduce enough weight to maintain the cubicles of the other 10 miners. This will kill the miner in the detached cubicle, but it will save the other ten.
entities: i,1 miner in the last cubicle,10 other miners in the other cubicles
outcomes: The 11 miners in the cubicles die
I remain trapped in the mine
